title: Brief
says: A brief: in full, the way down to it, its title and prose, the parts its prose places and its parts beneath, each a slot; as a face, its number, title and first paragraph.

title: Layout
says: A layout: its mounts as panes side by side, each a full slot.

title: List
says: A list of holons, each item a slot, a face unless the whole that opened it asks otherwise, numbered where the whole numbers its parts.

title: Type
says: A type: what its instances are, each field it declares with what it means and its shape, and its instances.

title: Field
says: The field itself, the root: its stores, the names each gives, and every type it holds.

title: Holon
says: Any holon nothing closer draws, the wildcard: what it is an instance of, and every value it holds, each reference a slot of what it points at.
